description: This file defines a C# interface 'ITransactionAgentStatistics' which provides methods and properties for tracking transaction statistics such as started, succeeded, failed, and throttled transactions within the Orleans project.

classes.name: ITransactionAgentStatistics
classes.description: Interface for tracking transaction statistics, including methods to record transactions and properties to retrieve counts.

methods.name: TransactionsStarted
methods.description: Gets the total number of transactions started.

methods.name: TransactionsSucceeded
methods.description: Gets the total number of transactions succeeded.

methods.name: TransactionsFailed
methods.description: Gets the total number of transactions failed.

methods.name: TransactionsThrottled
methods.description: Gets the total number of transactions throttled.
